integrity: The exact formula is proved by combinatorial splitting; global/local asymptotics invoke named classical partition formulas. Reproducibility uses a standalone exact-integer enumerator plus asymptotic trend checks; no formal/infinite certificate is claimed.
limitations: Applies to unrestricted integer partitions, fixed central windows and asymptotic sizes; general linear-statistic local-limit results may provide earlier implied coverage. Independent mathematical or historical validation not performed.
title: A lattice-local Gaussian law for parity-weighted mass in integer partitions
